bav.translation: abbr. 二叶式主动脉瓣（Bicuspid Aortic Valve）；巴伐利亚（Bavaria ）；巴伐利亚人的（Bavarian）

bavaria.definition: n. a state in southern Germany famous for its beer; site of an automobile factory

bavarian cream.translation: 巴伐利亚乳脂；巴伐利亚奶油

bavarian splint.translation: [医] 巴伐利亚夹, 石膏夹

bavarians.translation:

bavin.definition:

   kindling fires; refuse of brushwood.
n. Impure limestone.
